title: warm, crunchy irish cod hash
description: a hearty, winey, crunchy irish dish made with fajita seasoned cod and served in a solo dinner portion with a pasta-water emulsion.
instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in the bottom of a large dutch oven over medium-high heat.
add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
add the fajita seasoned cod fillets to the dutch oven and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
remove the cod from the pot and set aside.
add the diced potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
add the wine to the pot and stir to deglaze, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
add the pasta water to the pot and stir to combine.
return the cod to the pot and stir to coat with the pasta-water emulsion.
transfer the hash to a serving dish and top with grated cheddar cheese and chopped parsley.
season with salt and black pepper to taste.
